product.title: Iubirea secretă a Regelui Soare
product.description: Având ca fundal istoric decadenta curte franceză a secolului al XVII-lea, romanul Sandrei Gulland te captivează de la primele pagini ndash; tânăra și excentrica Louise reușește să îmblânzească un armăsar sălbatic alb cu ajutorul magiei negre. Această întâmplare o va urmări întreaga viață, influențându-i-o în moduri nebănuite.Prea săracă să se mărite sau să intre la o mănăstire, Louise este acceptată ca doamnă de companie la curtea lui Ludovic al XIV-lea, unde Regele Soare se îndrăgostește de ea. Pe măsură ce iubirea lor devine tot mai puternică, Louise îi dăruiește regelui patru copii, este făcută ducesă și se bucură de favoruri imense la curte, ca amantă oficială. Însă intrigi periculoase îi vor amenința poziția privilegiată, locul în inima lui Ludovic și chiar viața.Sandra Gulland a devenit cunoscută publicului american odată cu publicarea, în 1995, a trilogiei dedicate lui Josephine Bonaparte și epocii napoleoniene ndash; Josephine B. Trilogy. Succesul următoarelor sale romane de ficțiune istorică a trecut Oceanul, iar în prezent cărțile sale sunt traduse în peste zece limbi.

## Immerse Yourself in the Glittering Intrigue of the French Court

Dive into a captivating journey of forbidden love and dangerous secrets with *The Secret Love of the Sun King*. Set against the opulent, yet decadent backdrop of the 17th-century French court, this historical fiction novel by Sandra Gulland promises an unforgettable reading experience. From the first page, you'll be drawn into a world defined by glittering balls, political machinations, and the irresistible pull of fate.

The story centers on Louise, a young, eccentric woman whose life takes a dramatic turn when she accidentally tempers a wild-haired nobleman with her mastery of black magic. This magical encounter sets Louise on a path that will forever change her destiny.

## A Love Story Amidst Royal Intrigue

Louiseâs journey leads her to the court of Louis XIV, known as the Sun King. Unable to marry or enter a convent, she is accepted into service as a lady-in-waiting. Here, amidst the splendor and rigid hierarchy of the French monarchy, she captures the heart of the powerful king himself.

As their love deepensâa forbidden connection that defies social conventionâLouise becomes more than just an admirer; she bears four children for Louis XIV. She is elevated to duchess and granted immense favor at court, becoming the official mistress. However, this privileged position comes with grave dangers. Whispers of conspiracy and dangerous intrigues constantly threaten not only her status but also her life and her place in the king's heart.

### About the Author: Sandra Gulland

Sandra Gulland is a celebrated author of historical fiction. She first gained international acclaim with her 1995 trilogy dedicated to Josephine Bonaparte and the Napoleonic era (*Josephine B. Trilogy*). Her success has spanned oceans, establishing herself as a master storyteller whose richly detailed novels are translated into over ten languages worldwide. *The Secret Love of the Sun King* is a testament to her ability to weave grand historical narratives with deeply personal romance.

## Why Read This Historical Masterpiece?

If you enjoy sweeping stories of royalty, political drama, and intense passionâespecially those set during pivotal moments in European historyâthis book is for you. Experience the breathtaking scope of 17th-century French life through the eyes of Louise.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What historical period is this novel set in?**
A: The story is set during the 17th century, within the decadent and powerful French court ruled by Louis XIV.

**Q: Is this book standalone or part of a trilogy?**
A: While the author has written trilogies (such as her Josephine Bonaparte series), *The Secret Love of the Sun King* can be enjoyed independently as a captivating historical romance.

**Q: Does the plot involve magic?**
A: Yes, the narrative involves elements of black magic, which plays a crucial role in Louise's life and relationship with the nobleman.
